checks.description: The official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset. Brand rule: the logo ships on everything — no asset renders without the logo badge, and no skin removes the logo lockup.

Every built-in skin validates against skin-schema.json (cwi-skin/v1): all required tokens present, skin_id matches ^[a-z0-9-]+$, colors are hex, enums (style, intensity, animation, font_style, label_case) are in-vocabulary.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.
EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (pack, schema, card, builder, page, hub device, contact) is live, and the APPLY block is a valid skin-token snippet.

evidence.brand-token-discipline: index.html header logo, announce.html header logo, skin-builder.html header logo — logo.jpg on all three visual assets
evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/CONFIGURE/APPLY reference skins.json, schema, item-card, builder, page, walkman hub, hp@cumulativeweb.com — all live per gate 2
evidence.skin-schema-conformance: 4/4 built-in skins pass schema validation in automated gate 3 (required keys, hex colors, enum vocabulary, skin_id pattern)
evidence.white-label-config: gate 4 builds a temp config.json override (orgName/productName/colors) through build.py and confirms the overrides land in index.html with no leftover tokens

self_evaluation.run: automated: skin/test.py gate 4 evaluates the product against this rubric
